Package hr.fesb.java.bank

Class Account

java.lang.Object
hr.fesb.java.bank.Account
All Implemented Interfaces:
Reportable, Transactable
Direct Known Subclasses:
BusinessAccount, CheckingAccount, SavingsAccount
public abstract class Account extends Object implements Transactable, Reportable
Abstract base class for all account types. Implements common deposit logic, transaction recording, and account state.
